title: Red Hat Security Advisory: Red Hat Hardened Images RPMs Security Update
description: A vulnerability (CVE-2026-128085) was found in OpenTelemetry-Go used in Red Hat Hardened Images RPMs, allowing a denial of service (DoS) via excessive memory consumption. The flaw involves improper handling of Unicode replacement characters during attribute length truncation, enabling crafted telemetry data to bypass size limits and cause resource exhaustion. The impact is limited to increased memory use and processing overhead without compromising system integrity or confidentiality. Red Hat has issued an update including fixed RPMs for grafana13.2. No mitigation other than applying the update is currently recommended.
